name: 2D platformer (run, jump)
pitch: A small eared creature runs, jumps and stomps across a hand-typed level of pits, spikes, crawlers and moving platforms to a glowing door.
controls: A/D or arrows to run, Space (or W / Up) to jump (hold for higher), S + Space to drop through wooden platforms, jump against a wall to wall jump. Gamepad works; touch has no jump button yet.
use_when: any game seen from the side: classic platformers, precision platformers, side-scrolling adventures, metroidvania-style rooms, auto-runners seen from the side. Levels are text maps the agent can type.
already_good: Run with separate speed-up, stop and turn rates, on the ground and in the air
Jump with variable height, coyote time, buffering, apex hang, heavier falling and a fall-speed cap
Corner correction: slips round ceiling corners, lifts onto ledges a few pixels short
One-way platforms, moving platforms that carry you, wall slide and wall jump
A camera with look-ahead and a vertical dead zone, clamped to the level
Levels typed as text, drawn with automatic grass caps and edges in one draw call
A parallax backdrop painted from the palette
Half-second respawn at checkpoints, a generous stomp, an end card that says why
